e.title: bayesian-pricing
e.summary: 分层贝叶斯保险定价（burning-cost，PyMC 5，PyPI 0.2.4）：薄数据段 partial pooling 可信度因子，RMSE 改善 20-40%
e.summary_en: Hierarchical Bayesian insurance pricing (burning-cost, PyMC 5, PyPI 0.2.4): partial pooling credibility for thin-data segments, 20-40% RMSE improvement
e.summary_hk: 分層貝葉斯保險定價（burning-cost，PyMC 5，PyPI 0.2.4）：薄數據段 partial pooling 可信度因子，RMSE 改善 20-40%
e.body: bayesian-pricing（burning-cost，PyMC 5，PyPI v0.2.4）做薄数据段的分层贝叶斯定价：当费率网格的单元数超过保单的索赔数时，partial pooling（部分合并）给出可信估计——基准测试显示薄单元（20-50 保单年）RMSE 改善 20-40%，厚单元不受影响（可信度因子趋近 1）。对 RIAA：薄数据问题是费率厘定的经典痛点（[[insurance-credibility]] 的贝叶斯现代版）——与 [[insurance-distributional-glm]]（分布 GLM）、[[insurance-gam]]（GAM）配套：GLM/GAM 管主模型，bayesian-pricing 管薄单元；「多维度网格 + 大部分空单元」正是英国个人险真实场景；burning-cost 家族第 22 个成员（PyMC 现代贝叶斯栈）。
e.body_en: bayesian-pricing (burning-cost, PyMC 5, PyPI v0.2.4) does hierarchical Bayesian pricing for thin-data segments: when your rating grid has more cells than your book has claims, partial pooling gives credible estimates — benchmarks show 20-40% RMSE improvement on thin cells (20-50 policy-years) while thick cells are unaffected (credibility factor approaches 1). For RIAA: the thin-data problem is the classic ratemaking pain point (the Bayesian modernisation of [[insurance-credibility]]) — pairs with [[insurance-distributional-glm]] (distributional GLM) and [[insurance-gam]] (GAM): GLM/GAM handle the main model, bayesian-pricing handles thin cells; 'multi-dimensional grid with mostly empty cells' is the real UK personal lines scenario; the 22nd member of the burning-cost family (modern PyMC Bayesian stack).
e.body_hk: bayesian-pricing（burning-cost，PyMC 5，PyPI v0.2.4）做薄數據段的分層貝葉斯定價：當費率網格的單元數超過保單的索賠數時，partial pooling（部分合併）給出可信估計——基準測試顯示薄單元（20-50 保單年）RMSE 改善 20-40%，厚單元不受影響（可信度因子趨近 1）。對 RIAA：薄數據問題是費率釐定的經典痛點（[[insurance-credibility]] 的貝葉斯現代版）——與 [[insurance-distributional-glm]]（分佈 GLM）、[[insurance-gam]]（GAM）配套：GLM/GAM 管主模型，bayesian-pricing 管薄單元；「多維度網格 + 大部分空單元」正是英國個人險真實場景；burning-cost 家族第 22 個成員（PyMC 現代貝葉斯棧）。
